alternative: tagged MMID mainly executes active work or overlaps other critical work; pair density alone cannot imply latency saving
bound_rule: intersect tagged MMID intervals with server prefill decode ranges, then subtract overlap with tagged pread/upload; report per-wave active/all pairs separately; no speedup estimate without exclusive removable cost
conditional_run_rule: next run only if previous run passes resource/output gates; profiler only after control and plain C15 have the same four-token result
decision_rule: investment screen only: if active/all prefill wave pairs <=0.75 and prefill MMID time without tagged pread/upload >=20% of C43 original prefill, consider scoped compaction with prospective canonical reference and budget; otherwise pivot to prefix/session/residency; no timing promotion from profiler
failure_policy: stop affected unit on mismatch, telemetry/guard error or profiler absence; preserve receipt, no hidden retry
hypothesis: material prefill MMID occupancy includes sparse inactive parked pairs that a compact execution might avoid
idle_admission: 300 contiguous seconds <=1 s cadence, start <=50/50/45 C, later arms match first final baseline within 5/5/3 C, <=900 s

investment_screen.interpretation: both are diagnostic necessary conditions for prototype investment, neither predicts speedup

measurement_freeze_rule: fresh preflight must be committed before the first run; each prior receipt and idle must be committed before the next arm
numerical_gate: greedy four-token message/finish reason equality between original and C15; full logits same-profile bitwise NOT_RUN, so diagnostic timing is never promoted
objective: phase-align CPU streamed MMID and count active token-expert pairs per wave in one diagnostic cold513 request

phase_marker_contract.numeric_scope: four greedy output tokens equal C43 original and C15 plain; full logits bitwise NOT_RUN
phase_marker_contract.prefill: C46_SERVER_PREFILL_DECODE around llama_decode while slot PROCESSING_PROMPT or DONE_PROMPT

profile: P12 ngl12, ub32, slots32, full-SWA 8K, original backend; C15 differs only by optional NVTX/counter instrumentation
profiler_command: systemd-run --user --scope E18 -- env -u LD_PRELOAD PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools nsys profile --trace=nvtx --sample=none --force-overwrite=false --output results/c46-wave-phase-20260928T0857Z/raw/c46-phase-profile -- python3 tools/c46_wave_phase.py results/c46-wave-phase-20260928T0857Z --run --measurement-commit <freeze-commit>
resource_envelope: E18 18 GiB cgroup, zero swap, RSS <=16 GiB, cgroup <=16.5 GiB, GPU total <=6500 MiB, MemAvailable >=6 GiB, CPU95 warning/CPU100 stop, GPU80 and NVMe70 stop
workload: single synthetic 513-ID cold prompt, greedy cap 4 tokens; no prior prefix, no prompt-cache reuse
